_comment: Build-in-public projects the content-machine produces + distributes on a cadence. Each project reuses the viral reel formula (data/kb/viral_reel_formula.md), the repurposing agent, the scheduler.py auto-publish daemon (LinkedIn/IG/Threads), and UTM star-attribution.

projects.name: autopilot-jobhunt
projects.pitch: Free AI job agent: scans 130+ careers pages nightly, scores roles vs your resume with an LLM, Telegram-pings top matches, drafts tailored applications.
projects.honesty_guardrail: Scans, scores, notifies, drafts. Does NOT auto-apply. Never say 'auto-applies'.

angle_rotation: new companies added to the scan
a real job a user landed via the shortlist
a live LLM score example (0-100 vs resume)
a new feature shipped (draft, export, MCP)
behind-the-scenes: how the scoring prompt works

channels.instagram: reel + comment->DM (keyword 'jobs') via SuperProfile or CreatorFlow (ManyChat replacements)
channels.youtube_shorts: same cut; repo link line 1 of description + pinned comment
channels.linkedin: active (employer cleared); text post via scheduler.py, repo link in pinned first comment

projects._status: PLACEHOLDER — fill from creator's comment-automation + 2-tools spec before producing. Tool #1 = Claude; tool #2 = one free tool layered on top (or two other tools, at least one free).
projects.honesty_guardrail: State exactly what the tool does. Never overclaim.

cadence.format: comment->DM give-a-tool reel (1/week per DS + Life)
